title: Gibsons Curling Club

services.name: Curling Since 1976
services.desc: New this year is an online registration system from Curling Canada: Curling I/O. This new website service will make it easy for members to register, saving our volunteers countless hours in processing forms and organizing teams and schedules. You'll register with your email address, and then you'll get a link to click in your email - no passwords to remember. If you're a Gmail user, you can log in directly with your email. You'll set up your Curler Profile, sign the releases, add a league (or two) to your cart, and then check out. You can even indicate which leagues you want to spare for, add your locker charge, and order your bar cards! You can pay by cash, cheque, debit, or e-transfer.
